verdict.rationale: Remote is an HR, EOR and payroll platform with APIs, webhooks, a CLI and an MCP server, so asking about versioning automations is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows no product-native way to version, review, or roll back automations. Webhook delivery history and replays, plus forkable sample apps, are adjacent features or user-side workarounds and earn no credit.
